name: After § 212
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2024, Section III – Commission and executive agencies and the ninth, tenth and eleventh European Development Funds
part_text: 212 a. Expresses concern at the absence of a review of certain controversial cooperation agreements which, despite the lack of positive results and any tangible progress in their implementation, continue to be maintained, including the Political Dialogue and Cooperation Agreement (PDCA) with Cuba; further expresses concern that the Commission allocates funds in a non-transparent manner and is either unable or unwilling to disclose the full extent of financial support provided to Cuba; reiterates its call for increased transparency and for a comprehensive review of such controversial agreements;
